basic_profile.bio: A 38-year-old dance enthusiast from Hayward, CA, who works as a freelance writer for entertainment blogs. I've always had a passion for dance even though I've never been a dancer myself. I love spending my evenings watching dance shows and discussing them online. I'm married with two kids, and my spouse often joins me in watching our favorite shows. I typically browse Reddit late at night once the kids are asleep, around 10 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in dance shows comes from years of watching and reviewing them for various blogs. I've learned a lot about different dance styles and the entertainment industry through self-study and networking with professionals in the field.
